fields.works: Bengali Rāsa-pañcādhyāya (payāra); Padakalpataru 60 and 1372; a collection of 63 padas
fields.notes: A Vaiṣṇava poet, translator of the Rāsa-pañcādhyāya; padas 60 and 1372 of the Padakalpataru; 63 padas naming Bhūgarbha Gosvāmī, Ṭhākura Gadādhara, Pūjārī Gosvāmī (about 300 years ago). Not Hare Kṛṣṇa dāsa Bābājī #448.

fields.name: Harinārāyaṇa (rājā of Pañcakoṭa)
fields.place: Pañcakoṭa (from the Pareśnātha hills to Burdwan)
fields.guru: The son of Trimalla Bhaṭṭa of Raṅga-kṣetra (dīkṣā); Śrīnivāsa Ācārya (in whose care he was put)
fields.notes: Ruler of Pañcakoṭa; dīkṣā from the son of Trimalla Bhaṭṭa of Raṅga-kṣetra, who put him in Śrīnivāsa Ācārya's care; a devotee of Rāmacandra (Bhakti-ratnākara 9.303, 454-455); inspired Govinda Kavirāja to write the Rāma-caritra-gīta. (The Harinārāyaṇa disciple of Rasikānanda has his own record since 11-11-2026.)

fields.works: Madhu-keli-vallī (223 ślokas); Śrī Rūpa-Sanātana-stotra (49 ślokas); Śrī Rādhā-kuṇḍa-stava (104 ślokas)
fields.notes: A Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava of Gadādhara Bhaṭṭa's line (18th century); wrote the Madhu-keli-vallī on the Holī pastimes, the Śrī Rūpa-Sanātana-stotra and the Śrī Rādhā-kuṇḍa-stava.
A sannyāsī of another sect in Vṛndāvana whose red cloth, worn by Sanātana, made Jagadānanda Paṇḍita furious (CC Antya 13.50).

fields.name: Hussain Shah (Hussain Khān Saiyyad)
fields.notes: First a servant of Subuddhi Rāya, then king of Gauḍa; on his wife's advice made Subuddhi Rāya lose caste; Rūpa and Sanātana were his ministers; he held Lord Caitanya to be the Supreme Lord and imprisoned Sanātana (CC Madhya 25.180-182, 222; 19.18-30).

name: Gopāla dāsa (guru of Kṛṣṇa dāsa, Śrī Kṛṣṇa-vilāsa)

fields.disciples: Kṛṣṇadāsa «Kṛṣṇa-kiṅkara» (#2110), elder brother of Kāśīrāma dāsa
fields.notes: Guru of Kṛṣṇadāsa (#2110), elder brother of Kāśīrāma dāsa, whom he named Kṛṣṇa-kiṅkara; his own name is in the bhaṇitā of the Śrī Kṛṣṇa-vilāsa, said to be really compiled by that disciple.

fields.works: Nine padas in the Padakalpataru; eleven in the Pada-ratnāvalī (Subala-milana, Naukā-vilāsa…)

fields.notes: Eldest son of Hita Harivaṁśa (#492), served Śrī Rādhāvallabhajī in Vṛndāvana; brother of Sūryadāsa. Taken out of the record «Kṛṣṇa-dāsa Others» #1888 (07-11-2026).

Elder brother of Kāśīrāma dāsa (Bengali Mahābhārata) and of Gadādhara dāsa (#273); disciple of Gopāla dāsa (#2019), who named him Kṛṣṇa-kiṅkara; composed the Śrī Kṛṣṇa-vilāsa. Taken out of the record «Kṛṣṇa-dāsa Others» #1888 (07-11-2026).
